cues.en: Mike: So here we have another unsupervised learning project.
cues.zh: Mike：又來到一個「非監督式學習」專題。

cues.en: This is another great opportunity for you to use coding and simulations to explore concepts in statistics.
cues.zh: 這是另一個用程式和模擬探索統計概念的好機會。

cues.en: Of course, in this case, it's going to be about the one sample t-test.
cues.zh: 這次當然和單一樣本 t 檢定有關。

cues.en: So what you want to do here is explore the importance of the standard deviation, the sample standard deviation, and the significance of the t-test
cues.zh: 要探索標準差，也就是樣本標準差，對 t 檢定顯著性，

cues.en: and the value of the t-test.
cues.zh: 以及 t 值的重要性。

cues.en: So what you should do is start with the code from the previous video.
cues.zh: 從前一部影片的程式開始。

cues.en: So sample size of 20, population mean of .5.
cues.zh: 樣本大小 20、母體平均值 0.5。

cues.en: And then the idea is that you want to simulate these data over and over and over again with exactly the same mean, exactly the same sample size,
cues.zh: 反覆模擬資料，保持完全相同平均值、完全相同樣本大小，

cues.en: but you use different variances.
cues.zh: 但使用不同變異數。

cues.en: So you're going to need to figure out how to scale these random numbers to have standard deviations that you can specify here.
cues.zh: 需要想想如何縮放隨機數，讓標準差能在這裡指定。

cues.en: So you can see I'm going to, well, this doesn't say exactly, but I believe this is 0.1.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有確切寫，但我想是 0.1。

cues.en: Yeah, so start by using a standard deviation of 0.1, and then slowly increase the standard deviation of the data set up until 3.
cues.zh: 對，從標準差 0.1 開始，慢慢增加到 3。

cues.en: So standard deviations of 0.1 up to 3.
cues.zh: 也就是標準差從 0.1 到 3。

cues.en: And then you want to compute the T value, testing against the null hypothesis of zero, just like in this code in the previous video,
cues.zh: 再像前一部影片的程式一樣，對虛無假設 0 計算 t 值，

cues.en: and you want to compute the T value and the P value.
cues.zh: 計算 t 值和 P 值。

cues.en: Now, if you like, you know, you can do all of this stuff, but I'd actually just recommend using the ttest function.
cues.zh: 可以完整自行計算，但其實建議直接用 ttest 函式。

cues.en: Of course, if you're doing this in Python, you would use the corresponding Python ttest function that I showed in the previous video.
cues.zh: 如果使用 Python，當然用前一部影片展示的對應函式。

cues.en: And then what you want to do is make a figure that looks like this.
cues.zh: 接著做一張像這樣的圖。

cues.en: So plot the T values and plot the P values.
cues.zh: 畫出 t 值和 P 值。

cues.en: And you will see that the T values start off very high, not surprising because the standard deviation is very low.
cues.zh: 會看到 t 值一開始很高，不意外，因為標準差很低。

cues.en: And, you know, then you'll see the T values get smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 接著越來越小。

cues.en: And here the P values, you can see, these are all wildly significant, really, really small P values.
cues.zh: 這裡 P 值都非常顯著，非常非常小。

cues.en: And then the P values become really unstable.
cues.zh: 後來變得非常不穩定。

cues.en: Basically, they get all over the place.
cues.zh: 基本上到處跳動。

cues.en: It's pretty interesting to note that, even as you get all the way out here, you still get these fairly small T values, but you can still get pretty significant results.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，即使走到這麼遠，仍有相當小的 t 值，但仍可能得到相當顯著的結果。

cues.en: After you've computed the T values and the P values and you've plotted them, then it's also interesting to make a plot of the T values by the P values,
cues.zh: 計算並畫出 t 值和 P 值後，也可以再畫兩者相互對照的圖，

cues.en: because these are all paired with each other.
cues.zh: 因為它們彼此配對。

cues.en: And that's going to give you a plot that looks something like this, where we have the P values on the y axis and the T values on the x axis.
cues.zh: 會得到像這樣的圖，Y 軸是 P 值，X 軸是 t 值。

cues.en: Also, pretty interesting to contemplate.
cues.zh: 同樣很值得思考。
